judge_panel.reasoning: The reviewer does not challenge the Solomon1987 citation in Sec. 3.6 as being mischaracterised as a hydrodynamic simulation paper rather than an observational CO survey. The minor comment on §3.4 Equation (1) only mentions unit consistency for the Solomon (1997) formula, not the methodology mis-attribution of Solomon (1987).

The review does not mention Solomon et al. 1987 or challenge the claim that the GMC comparison was from hydrodynamic simulations rather than observations. The virial comment discusses qualitative support for bound clumps, not the citation misattribution.
The reviewer mentions Solomon et al. (1997) in relation to Equation 1 but does not comment on the citation of Solomon (1987) in Section 3.6 or the claim that it is a simulation-based study.

The reviewer never challenges the characterization of Solomon et al. (1987) as a hydrodynamic simulation paper. The review does not mention Solomon et al. (1987) at all, nor does it flag the mis-categorization of that reference's methodology in Section 3.6.

The reviewer's summary notes '~800 pc of the SSC' when describing the paper's findings, but never flags the discrepancy between ~80 pc in the Conclusions and ~800 pc in the Abstract and Section 3.5. No specific mention of this inconsistency appears anywhere in the report.

The reviewer summarizes the result as '~800 pc' and nowhere flags an inconsistency between conclusions and earlier sections/abstract about 80 pc versus 800 pc. There is no specific complaint about the conclusion bullet's spatial extent value.
The reviewer explicitly uses the correct value (800 pc) in their summary of the paper and does not flag the 80 pc typo present in the conclusions.

The reviewer consistently uses ~800 pc (e.g., 'compact CO emission within ~800 pc of the SSC') in the summary, matching the abstract and body text, and never flags the inconsistency between the Conclusions bullet (~80 pc) and the abstract/body (~800 pc). The factor-10 discrepancy introduced by the injection was not caught.

The minor comment on §3.4 Equation (1) only asks to double-check unit consistency (the constant 3.25×10⁷ and ν in GHz) but does not identify or challenge the incorrect (1+z)^{-1} exponent versus the canonical (1+z)^{-3}. This does not constitute detection of the injected error.

The reviewer mentions Eq. (1) only to say 'please double-check the unit consistency' and notes that ν_obs should be squared in the denominator, which matches the text. They do not flag the redshift factor or state that (1+z)^{-1} is incorrect relative to the standard Solomon formula.
While the reviewer comments on Equation 1, they only discuss the frequency term and unit consistency, failing to notice the incorrect exponent for the redshift factor (1+z).

The reviewer mentions checking unit consistency of Eq. (1) and the Solomon et al. (1997) expression in a minor comment (§3.4), but only asks about units and the constant 3.25×10⁷ — they do not flag the incorrect (1+z)^{-1} exponent versus the canonical (1+z)^{-3}. No specific mention of the redshift factor error is made.

The reviewer does not flag the inserted sentence claiming matched synthesized beams and no need for regridding, nor does it note the contradiction with the different beam sizes quoted immediately after or with Appendix A.3's regridding procedure. No comment in the report corresponds to this injection.

The review asks for the MRS and clarifies sensitivity differences, but does not identify any contradiction about matched synthesized beams, direct pixel-by-pixel comparison, or the need for regridding versus Appendix A.3/Table A.1. No methodology-setup inconsistency corresponding to the inserted sentence is flagged.

The reviewer notes the actual differing synthesized beam sizes in Major Comment 6 but does not flag the internal methodology contradiction where the text claims the beams were matched with no regridding needed.

The reviewer does not flag the internal contradiction between the injected sentence claiming 'matched synthesized beam' and 'no regridding needed' versus the different beam sizes quoted in the same paragraph (0.87x0.80 vs 1.21x1.04) and the regridding procedure described in Appendix A.3. None of the reviewer's comments address this specific methodology-setup inconsistency.
